Name: Prideful Town
Author: lyssaness
Description:
[color=#fff2cc][size=4]This mod adds a rainbow Plaza tile, Flowers instead of grave stones, flowers instead of thrown away cans, and also includes my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3798]A More Happy Dog House[/url] mod![/size]


Later updates will include changes to Pierre's shop sign and the community center! maybe more if anyone has suggestions.





[/color][center][color=#fff2cc]
To install;
[url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].﻿
Download and unzip the mod
Drop it into Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
Enjoy![/color][/center]
[color=#ff7700][u][center][size=3][b]Update: I've yet to check compatibility on all my mods, please bare with me.[/b][/size][/center][/u][/color]
